# Dallol audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/dallol-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set dallol` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `wind.mp3` is cut from "Desert binaural Wind.WAV" by Benbojangles, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Benbojangles/sounds/457159/.
- `mud.mp3` is cut from "Bubbling Mud with Steam" by ProductionNow, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/ProductionNow/sounds/352904/.
- `bubbles.mp3` is cut from "Mud Volcano Field - Salton Sea" by RTB45, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/RTB45/sounds/415608/.
